events.title: Indeterminacy in Music and Life
events.description:
Coming Soon! This music therapy workshop series invites neurodiverse participants to explore the experience of uncertainty in life, the comfort of predictability, and what it feels like to let go of control, through the lens of indeterminate and chance-based music.

Participants will engage in a multi-layered experience that combines:
- Education: learning about influential composers (Cage, Reich, Feldman, Cardew, Oliveros) and the styles and philosophies behind indeterminate, process-based, and chance music
- Music creation: active music making, improvisation, graphic score composition, field recordings, and sound experiments
- Performance and collaboration: sharing individual creations, performing group compositions, and reflecting on the collective musical experience
- Therapeutic exploration: processing personal experiences, emotions, and responses to uncertainty, both in music and in life

Each session is designed to balance group experiences—performing, improvising, sharing—with individual exploration, including take-home exercises that can be brought back to the group for discussion and reflection.

This series is a music therapy experience designed for neurodiverse participants who want to explore uncertainty in life and music, and how letting go of control can be both challenging and creatively freeing. Accommodations for different sensory, cognitive, and processing needs will be made at every session, and you are free to choose which of the group-based interaction and individual activities you would like to take part in.

This series is a combination of education, therapy, flow, composition, and performance, encouraging curiosity, creative expression, and mindful engagement with both sound and life. Music skill is not required to join; whether you have never played an instrument, are just beginning, or have a bit more experience, you are welcome here and will find areas to explore and grow at any level.

events.description: 'Tis the season for sharing and connection! Join our festive open discussion for music lovers. We'll listen to holiday tunes and heartwarming songs, and talk about the memories and feelings they evoke. Share a song that defines your holiday season—whether it's classic carols, festive pop, or a wintery ballad—and tell us the story behind it.
